conversion.continuous_score: 0 for speedup <= 1; otherwise 100 * log(speedup) / (log(10) + log(speedup)); 10x=50, asymptotic to 100 without upper clipping; independent of reference.patch
conversion.pass_fail: on every workload in the selected suite (four train or all six public and hidden final): latency < reference, inertia <= reference * 1.05, and mismatch <= reference + 0.002; all comparisons must pass

evaluation.continuous_score: 0 for speedup <= 1; otherwise 100 * log(speedup) / (log(10) + log(speedup)); 10x=50, asymptotic to 100 without upper clipping; independent of reference.patch
evaluation.suite_relation: train uses original public w0-w3; final freshly measures original w0-w5 together, public w0-w3 with the same train seeds and hidden w4-w5 with an independent deterministic seed domain; all six contribute to final score and PASS

metadata.isolation: Hidden final shapes, workload generator, seeds, reference patch, comparisons and evidence exist only in the Verifier GPU image. Agent images contain the public train shapes, naive starter and runtime content.

note: Provenance metadata moved out of policy.json by the task.toml migration; not read by the platform.
